figure1_concept.artwork: Vector scientific diagrams with an approved AI-generated raster fish; synthetic pseudo-UMAP, not an experimental result
figure1_concept.layout: Paired inputs and transparent Threadfin fish at left; functional GC-node and cycling/output-gradient maps at right
figure1_concept.size: Area proportional to synthetic captured-cell count for every clone point
figure1_concept.colour: Upper map: dominant captured RNA state. Lower map: vivid blue/teal/amber/rose continuous programme balance. Receptor-tree colours identify separate families, not RNA states.
figure1_concept.shape: All clone dots are circles; no timepoint marker shapes
figure1_concept.central_expansion: Some central profiles are larger by illustrative design only; empirical size uses captured cells, not map location
figure1_concept.bcr_input: Original membrane-Ig and H/L V(D)J-contig glyphs; grouping uses IGH with optional light-chain refinement
figure1_concept.receptor_tree_scope: Illustrative within-family sequence relationships; no common root across families, measured phylogeny or inferred output trajectory
figure1_concept.fin_extensions: Four tapered vector ribbons with pale gold/blue-green shading; overlapping pixel anchors and tangent-matched cubic joins extend the approved illustration organically

fish_asset.provenance: Built-in image generation from the user-supplied fish reference; user approved
fish_asset.rendering: Original RGBA pixels embedded at natural aspect ratio; vector fin extensions overlap the existing tips; source PNG unchanged

figure1_concept.algorithm_glyph: The unshrunk mean of RNA kernel feature vectors is a squared-distance Frechet mean in feature space; final profiles also use context adjustment, shrinkage and projection. No optimal-transport solver is claimed.
figure1_concept.selection_emphasis: Gold outline and aligned annotation identify a conceptual node; the outline is not a confidence region

visual_references.motif: Paired measurements, V(D)J segments and clone-network abstraction
Membrane BCR on a B cell, contigs and receptor-based grouping

figure1_concept.asset_reuse: Approved generated fish PNG embedded; no article artwork embedded
figure1_concept.continuum_interpretation: Idealised GC/cycling to output-associated profile variation; no imposed selection node or inferred temporal trajectory
figure1_concept.default_profile: Context-centred and shrunken kernel mean embedding; mean option remains available
figure1_concept.dashed_arrow: Candidate selection-to-cycling return; requires directional lineage/time evidence
figure1_concept.biological_scope: GC-specific hypothesis; not memory-to-GC re-entry, demonstrated fate or between-family ancestry
figure1_concept.study_scope: Fig. 2 model-antigen selection context and Fig. 3 infection population / output-gradient questions; studies not pooled

gc_reclustering.size_encoding: Area = 6 square points per captured cell

figure2_reporter_review.family_definition: Donor-private IGH V/J and nucleotide-junction sequence families
figure2_reporter_review.size_encoding: Area in square points = 1 + 5 * sqrt(captured cells)
figure2_reporter_review.inference_limit: Measured-gate association; no temporal fate or comparative method superiority

figure3_review.gc_reference_rule: reliable early families with GC fraction >=0.5; mean saved 2D coordinates
figure3_review.panel_E_limit: Descriptive RNA-derived association in a 2D display; not independent validation of maturation or GC origin
figure3_review.panel_F_denominator: all reliable families within each mouse, separately by treatment
figure3_review.panel_F_gc_rule: captured GC fraction >=0.5; no UMAP-distance classification
figure3_review.panel_F_limit: Different terminal mice at each day; changing captured repertoires, not tracked families or causal treatment effects
